mapper.insert:
insert into backlink_source (url, normalized_url, host, name, description, batch, note) values
(#{s.url}, #{s.normalizedUrl}, #{s.host}, #{s.name}, #{s.description}, #{s.batch}, #{s.note})
on conflict (normalized_url) do nothing
mapper.select: select id, url, normalized_url, host, name, description, batch, note, screen_status, http_status, final_url, check_error, checked_at, created_at from backlink_source order by id limit #{limit}
select id, url, normalized_url, host, name, description, batch, note, screen_status, http_status, final_url, check_error, checked_at, created_at from backlink_source where id = #{id}
select count(*) as total, count(distinct host) as hosts, count(*) - count(distinct host) as extra_entries_on_same_host from backlink_source
select screen_status as status, count(*) as count from backlink_source group by screen_status order by count desc
